case_title: Defective Smartphone and Disputed Product Liability

additional_evidence_concerns.reason: No independent battery safety report has been provided.
The case information does not establish whether the original charging adapter was used.
The report is available, but its findings are disputed by the claimant.

expected_defects.description: The claimant states that every manufacturer is automatically liable for all product-related damage regardless of the cause.
The independent battery safety report is missing.
The use of the original charging adapter is unclear.
The claimant disputes the manufacturer's inspection conclusions.

expected_review.reason: All four standard complaint documents are present, but battery safety evidence and the disputed inspection findings require further examination.

expected_outcome.recommended_action: Obtain an independent battery safety report, clarify the charging adapter details and examine the manufacturer's inspection findings.

testing_notes: All four standard checklist documents should be marked Present.
The missing battery safety report must be identified as additional evidence.
The unclear charging adapter information must be flagged.
The system must not assume that battery damage automatically establishes legal liability.
The system must not automatically decide the complaint.
